contexts.text: Let us make bricks (literally, Let us brick bricks,)() = the falsities which they fashioned for themselves. A stone = truth; hence a brick, because made by man, = falsity, for a brick is artificially made stone. Illustrated.
They had brick for stone = that they had falsity instead of truth.
In clay and in bricks () = on account of the evils which they found out and the falsities which they fashioned.
To brick bricks () = to the fictitious and false things which are being injected. Explained. AC 7116.
To make bricks () = to receive fictitious and false things.
To brick bricks = to endure injected falsities.
Under Furnace, see these references. AC 7519:end. AE 177:end.
Houses seen that were constructed of bricks, plastered over.
They sacrifice in gardens, and burn incense upon bricks () = worship from falsities of doctrine which are from their Own intelligence... Bricks = falsities. AE 659:2.
Bricks = the falsities which are fashioned, and which do not cohere with truths.
